resources.string: Connect IP, port, fake SNI and method for configs that point at 127.0.0.1:40443

Works like RstaNG. Import or make a config whose server is 127.0.0.1 and port 40443 (its TLS server name and host are the real ones); it then goes through the built-in engine, which connects to the IP below and disguises the first packets with the fake SNI. Changes apply to the next connection or test.
A clean IP of the CDN the server is behind
A server name the filter lets through, such as cdnjs.cloudflare.com
It starts with a connection or a test and stops when they end.
